name: DOB Certificate Of Occupancy
description:
This dataset contains records of Certificates of Occupancy issued by the Department of Buildings, sampled here at 5,000 rows with 25 columns. Each row represents a certificate of occupancy filing tied to a specific job and building, including the job number and type, certificate of occupancy issue date, building identification number (BIN), borough, house number, street name, block, lot, postcode, and counts of proposed and existing dwelling units. It also includes raw application and filing status values, item number, issue type, geographic coordinates (latitude and longitude), community board, council district, census tract, BBL (borough-block-lot), neighborhood tabulation area (NTA), and a combined location field.

The data can be used to analyze when and where certificates of occupancy are issued, track changes in dwelling unit counts associated with completed jobs, compare issuance patterns across boroughs, districts, or neighborhoods, and map certificate locations using the coordinates or BBL. It is useful for housing development
